questions.q_en: A man travels at the speed of 12 km/h on foot and 36 km/hr on bike. If he covered 240 km distance in 12 hours, then find the time taken by him on bike.
questions.solution_en:
Let the time taken on the bike be 't' hours.

According to question,

36 * t + (12 - t) * 12 = 240

=> 36t + 144 - 12t = 240

=> 24t = 96

=> t = 4

Hence, the required time is 4 hours.

questions.q_en:
a, b, c and 23 are four distinct number and the HCF of each pair of numbers (23, a) ; (23, b) ; (23, c) is 23 where a, b, c are each less than 95 and a < b < c. what is the value of

(b * c + a)/2
questions.solution_en:
The four distinct numbers are 23, a, b and c

HCF is always the factor of the given numbers

a, b, c should be multiple of 23 as the HCF is 23

Only possible multiples of a, b and c is 2, 3 and 4 respectively

As a, b and c each are less than 95

So, a = 23 * 2 = 46

b = 23 * 3 = 69

c = 23 * 4 = 92

(b * c + a)/2 = (69 * 92 + 46)/2

=> (6348 + 46)/2 = 6394/2

=> 3197

questions.q_en:
If 2x + y - 3z = 0, then find the value of 
4x2 + y2 + 9z2

questions.q_en: Two taps K and L can fill a tank in 40 hours and 60 hours respectively. Tap K opened first and after 10 hours tap L opened. How much time in total will be taken to fill the tank?
questions.solution_en:
Part of tank filled by tap K in 10 hours = 10/40 = 1/4

Remaining part to be filled = 1 - 1/4 = 3/4

Time taken by taps K and L together to fill 3/4th part of the tank

= 3/4 * 1/(1/40 + 1/60)

= 18 hours

Therefore, total time taken = 10 + 18 = 28 hours

questions.q_en: A square pyramid is placed in a cubical box having the edge of same length as that of the pyramid's base. Height of the square pyramid is thrice that of box. Find the ratio of volume of square pyramid to that of box?
questions.solution_en:
Let the side of cube be 'a'.

Then the volume of cube, V1 = a3

Volume of pyramid = (1/3) X Area of base x Height = (1/3) x a2 x h

Heights of square pyramid is thrice that of box i.e., h = 3a

Therefore Volume of pyramid = (1/3) x a2 x 3a

V2 = a3

Therefore, V2/V1 = a3/a3 = 1:1

Study the given bar- graphs and answer the question that follows.


Turnover of Company X (Product-wise: A,B,C,D and E)

Approximately what is the share in the total profit enjoyed by A and E together?
questions.solution_en:
Here

Turnover of A = ₹30 lakh

Turnover of E = ₹60 lakh

Profitability percentage of A = 25%

Profitability percentage of E = 25%

Turnover of B = ₹40 lakh

Turnover of C = ₹20 lakh

Turnover of D = ₹50 lakh

Profitability percentage of B = 7.5%

Profitability percentage of C = 20%

Profitability percentage of D = 7.5%

So,

Profit of A = 30 X (25/100)= ₹7.5 lakh

Profit of E = 60 X (25/100)= ₹15 lakh

Profit of B = 40 X (7.5/100)= ₹3 lakh

Profit of C = 20 X (20/100)= ₹4 lakh

Profit of D = 50 X (7.5/100)= ₹3.75 lakh

Total Profit of Company X = 7.5 + 15 + 3 + 4 + 3.75

Total Profit of Company X = ₹33.25 lakh

Share of A and E = (7.5 + 15) / 33.25 X 100%

Share of A and E ≈ 67.67% ≈ 70%

questions.q_en: If (2p + 3)3 + (3p - 5)3 + (p - 2)3 = (2p + 3)(3p - 5)(3p - 6), then what is the value of 'p'?
questions.solution_en:
We know, a3 + b3 + c3 - 3abc = (a + b + c)(a2 + b2 + c2 - ab - bc - ac)

Here, (2p + 3)3 + (3p - 5)3 + (p - 2)3 = (2p + 3)(3p - 5)(3p - 6) = 3(2p + 3)(3p - 5)(p - 2)

This means, a3 + b3 + c3 = 3abc

Then, a3 + b3 + c3 - 3abc = 0

And, (a + b + c)(a2 + b2 + c2 - ab - bc - ac) = 0

So, a + b + c = 0

Now, (2p + 3) + (3p - 5) + (p - 2) = 0

p = 2/3

questions.q_en: What is the sum of cubes of number from (11 to 20)?
questions.solution_en:
Sum of cubes of first n natural numbers = ((n x (n +1))/2)2

Sum of cubes of the numbers from (11 to 20)

= (Sum of cubes of numbers from 1 to 20) - (Sum of cubes of the numbers from 1 to 10)

= ((20 x21)/2)2 - ((10 x11)/2)2

= (210)2 - (55)2

= 44100 - 3025 = 41075

questions.q_en: Nita gives Nidhi a head start of 20 m in a race of 600 m. Nita runs at the speed of 18 km/h. If Nita managed to beat Nidhi by 25 seconds, find the ratio of speeds of Nita and Nidhi if they started the race at the same time.
questions.solution_en:
[To convert km/h in m/s, multiply with 5/18]

18 km/h = 5 m/sec

Time taken by Nita to cover 600 m = 600/5 = 120 seconds

Distance covered by Nidhi = 600 - 20 = 580 m

Time taken by Nidhi to cover 580 m = 120 + 25 = 145 seconds

The speed of Nishi = 580/145 = 4 m/sec

Hence, the required ratio = 5 /4 = 5 : 4

questions.q_en: Pranav borrows a sum of ₹335180 at the rate of 13% per annum simple interest. At the end of the first year, he repays ₹23060 towards return of principal amount borrowed. If Pranav clears all pending dues at the end of the second year, including interest payment that accrued during the first year, how much does he pay (in ₹) at the end of the second year?
questions.solution_en:
Interest for the first year:

SI = (335180 X 13 X 1)/100 = ₹43573.40

Principal remaining after first year:

=> ₹335180 - ₹23060 = ₹312120

Interest for the second year:

SI = (312120 X 13 X 1)/100 = ₹40575.60

Total Interest = ₹43573.40 + ₹40575.60 = ₹84149

Total amount to be paid at the end of the second year:

=> Total Amount = ₹312120 + ₹84149 = ₹396269
